logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-05 verification memo (fleet depot charger package selection). Two-panel analytical chart on one linear scale. Left panel: measured energy per candidate on the shared acceptance basis — P2 15, P3 24, P1 44, P4 64 kWh — drawn as vertical bars at a fixed 5 pixels per kWh with baseline at y=410 (heights 75, 120, 220, 320 px), gridlines every 20 kWh, bar order P2, P3, P1, P4, with red gap annotations of +9, +20, +20 kWh between adjacent bars and winner-to-last spread 49 kWh stated in the axis caption. P2 highlighted green as the selection; P4 in muted red as the highest-energy candidate sitting at the defect ceiling. Right panel: spare defect slots under the ceiling of five — P1 2, P2 4, P3 2, P4 0 — at a fixed 40 pixels per slot, with P4's zero drawn as a red baseline marker. Footer states quality margins over the 80 floor: P1 +20, P2 +15, P3 +11, P4 +8. All values come only from the trusted table; no cost, delivery or reliability data is shown.
